items.title: Low to Moderate flash flood risk likely over few watersheds and neighbourhoods of following Met Sub-divisions during next 24 hours. Alappuzha, Kottayam and Pathanamthitta districts.

Low to Moderate flash flood risk likely over few watersheds  and neighbourhoods of following Met Sub-divisions during next 24 hours. Malappuram, Palakkad, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kottayam, Thrissur, Kozhikode and Wayanad districts
Very Heavy Rain is very likely to occur at isolated places over Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Kannur, Kasaragod, Kollam in next 24 hours.
Extremely Heavy Rain is very likely to occur at isolated places over Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta in next 24 hours.
